lean.statement: For real sequences a and δ and a natural number n, if every i<n satisfies |a (i+1) - a i| ≤ δ i, then |a n - a 0| ≤ ∑ i in Finset.range n, δ i.
approved_definition_context: Finset.range n consists of the natural numbers 0 through n-1.
Absolute value and subtraction are the ordinary real operations.
The premise is universally quantified over natural indices i together with the strict inequality i<n.
The conclusion is deterministic and finite; it contains no probability measure or limiting process.
